directive.gatingQuestion: Does strong sales/order growth versus lower year-over-year segment margin constitute a material contradiction that must remain unresolved?
directive.whyItMatters: The packet routes unresolved_material_contradiction to Deep Resolver and cannot clear that defect while the tension is mislabeled as logically unresolved.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: Eaton Q2 2026 issuer results already present in active packet lineage.
directive.successCondition: Classify whether both observations can simultaneously be true, preserve margin/integration caution, and remove contradiction status only if no factual conflict remains.

adjudication.evidence: The active packet already records strong sales/order/backlog growth and separately records lower year-over-year segment margin as a non-gating risk.
adjudication.inference: Revenue/order growth and lower segment margin can coexist because mix, integration costs, pricing/cost timing, and acquired capacity can alter margin while demand expands. The two claims therefore create an execution caution, not a factual contradiction.
adjudication.gateImpact: Resolve unresolved_material_contradiction only. Preserve margin/mix/integration risk and all Alpha-owned score/provenance failures.

failedStrategy: Prior Resolver runs preserved the same tension as unresolved despite an existing disposition that it was not a blocker.
changedStrategy: Adjudicated logical compatibility directly from active packet evidence rather than re-searching the same downstream symptom.
